provenance.capture_description: Captured read-only with the Python reference Pydantic models. For each request model and nested Location, WorkChange progress/release/handoff, PlanUpdate, and TaskDefinition, vary fields by omission, null, boolean, integer, empty string, array, object, and string; include unknown fields. Successful outputs are model_dump(exclude_unset=True). Expected results are frozen data; tests require no Python runtime or generator.
